about: Lists interview-rules holds by input template (engine/src/interview-rules.ts), each with a reason, until the gate wave fixes its cause. early_completion: inputs left reachable and unanswered when the interview reports a return complete. order_dependent_reach: inputs reachable at an incomplete state of a complete return that its bank-order walk never asks (an order-dependent leak). walked_unused: inputs the bank-order walk asks that the complete return's evaluation does not read (a pruning opportunity; reports/2025/interview_pruning.md). A template not listed fails the check, and a listed template no longer seen fails until it is removed, so each list may only shrink. Most entries are conjunctions to rewrite as nested choose.

walked_unused.dependent.canada_mexico: dependent.resident is any(citizen, canada_mexico); asked although a later answer (the relationship or age tests) leaves residency unread
walked_unused.dependent.disabled: read by dependent.qc_age and dependent.income_exception, conjunctions a later dependent answer decides without it
walked_unused.dependent.gross_income: dependent.qr_income, read by the qualifying-relative conjunction a later dependent answer decides without it
walked_unused.dependent.months: dependent.lived_half and dependent.kidnap_residency, read by conjunctions a later dependent answer decides without them
walked_unused.dependent.multiple_support: an operand of the dependent.qualifying_relative conjunction, which another operand decides later in bank order
walked_unused.dependent.supported: an operand of the dependent.qualifying_relative conjunction, which another operand decides later in bank order
walked_unused.eic.qc_of_another: an operand of the EIC step 3 and 4 conjunctions; on the minimal returns (no earned income) a later EIC answer decides eic.eligible without it
walked_unused.household.home_cost: an operand of household.hoh_absence and household.test2_met (all), decided by a later household or dependent answer
walked_unused.person.sav_excess: person.sav_excess_gate is all(person.sav_w2 > 0, person.sav_excess); asked before the W-2 contribution amounts decide the first operand
walked_unused.person.work_ssn: read by the person-roster counts (household, Schedule 1-A) whose conjunctions a later answer decides without it
walked_unused.s8812.combat_pay: ira.combat_gate is all(ira.any_trad, s8812.combat_pay), and combat pay (order 20) is asked before the traditional IRA questions (order 22) that decide ira.any_trad
